d: Lettering skills are put to the test during a graffiti flash challenge, and the portrait elimination tattoo leaves the four remaining artists with no room for error.
The final artists are given a 12-hour master canvas challenge playing to their favorite styles, and an Ink Master is chosen.
The artists head to the morgue to face off in their first Flash Challenge, and tattoo virgins experience their first tastes of ink during the Elimination Tattoo.
The artists test their ingenuity by camouflaging models, a medical emergency threatens the future of one competitor, and NFL star Terrell Suggs joins as a guest judge.
The artists test their line skills in the barbershop, military veterans sit in for an American classic style Elimination Tattoo, and tattoo legend Richard Stell guest judges.
The artists face off in a three-round Flash Challenge, a canvas asks for a tattoo with a unique placement, and NBA star Matt Barnes joins as a guest judge.
Canvases get tattoos inside of their mouths in the Flash Challenge, the artists design horror-themed tattoos for their canvases, and a contestant faces a medical emergency.
The artists etch detailed designs into firearms, and a pinup Elimination Tattoo proves disastrous for some of the contestants.
George Lucas awards a special prize for the Flash Challenge, and the artists design tattoos for Star Wars superfans.
The artists pair up for a gradation Flash Challenge and a good vs. evil Elimination Tattoo, and tattoo legend Freddy Negrete joins as a guest judge.
The artists burn designs into a cowgirl's chaps during the Flash Challenge, and legendary artist Mike Rubendall assesses Japanese-style tattoos during the elimination round.
The artists are tasked with customizing guitars for Dave, a canvas gets sick during the Elimination Tattoo, and artist Forrest Cavacco joins the panel as a guest judge.
The artists face off against Oliver in a Jagermeister micro-tattoo Flash Challenge, and legendary artist Bob Tyrrell joins as a guest judge to assess portrait tattoos.
The four remaining artists meet their canvases for the last elimination tattoo, the judges choose the final three contestants, and the epic final challenge is revealed.
The contestants return to reflect on their eliminations, the finalists and their master canvases participate in a 24-hour tattoo challenge, an Ink Master is chosen.
The artists create single-needle tattoos for inmates in their first Flash Challenge, and canvases seek cover-ups in the elimination challenge.
The artists team up to create customized grills for lowrider cars, canvases sit for gory tattoos, and NFL star Chris Johnson joins the panel as a guest judge.
The artists test their texture skills in a sexy Flash Challenge, a difficult canvas leads to a second elimination, and tattoo veteran Tony Hundahl joins as a guest judge.
The artists must assemble their own tattoo machines before tattooing bar codes onto their canvases, and tattoo machine innovator Seth Ciferri joins as a guest judge.
The artists tackle tattooing over scarred skin in the Flash Challenge, a canvas asks for a Day of the Dead portrait of Tatu Baby, and artist Chuey Quintanar is a guest judge.
The artists transform models into animals in the Flash Challenge, and veteran tattoo artist Troy Denning judges the artists' Asian-style tattoos in the elimination challenge.
